description.content: Teads Report API v1

Trigger an asynchronous report processing

Response JSON body attributes:

- 
id (String):  unique identifier

- 
start (Timestamp ISO 8601): timestamp when the report request was registered in Teads backend

- 
lastStatusUpdate (Timestamp ISO 8601): timestamp of the last internal status update in Teads backend,

- 
status (String): report status, it can following values:

- queued Teads platform has put the report in the queue to be processed, this stage may vary depending on our resources availability
- processing The report is now being computed
- error An issue prevented the report from being computed, please look at message field for more details
- finished The report is now finished, you can download the result at url field.
- killed The report was canceled during its process

- 
valid (Boolean): true if the format and content report request is valid and is being process

- 
reportProgress (Object): object containing report progress

- stepMax (Number): number of steps to finish report
- step (Number): current step in the report
- progressMax (Number): max progress to finish step
- progress (Number): current progress in the step

All filters, except for date are optional.  emails and format are also optional groups. If not present, they will use their "default" value which are presented in the example above.
Filters fields are based on ids, ie use placements : [ 1 ] for filtering on placement with id 1.
Exceptions are _status that take the status as stored in database, ie 1 for active and format which takes string format, ie inread for inread insertion/placement.

Warning: format filtering can lead to long or failing requests, due to the amount of computing power it requires. If you encounter issues while using the format filter, we recommend dropping it and filtering afterwards if necessary.

Parameters

    
        parameter
        type
        default
        required
        description
    
    
        dimensions
        array(text)
        -
        Yes
        List of dimensions to query by
    
    
        filters.date.start
        text
        -
        Yes
        Lower-bound timestamp (ISO8601 format)
    
    
        filters.date.end
        text
        -
        Yes
        Upper-bound timestamp (ISO8601 format)
    
    
        filters.date.timezone
        text
        inferred from filters.date.start timestamp
        -
        The timezone you would like the report to be rendered in: used to resolve DST shifts (should be provided if filters.date.start is specified in UTC/GMT)
    
    
        metrics
        array(text)
        -
        Yes
        List of metrics to return
    
    
        emails
        array(text)
        []
        -
        E-mail addresses of report recipients
    
    
        filters.ad_sources
        array(int)
        []
        -
        filter of adsource id (ex: Google DBM id "3")
    
    
        filters.ad_status
        array(int)
        []
        -
        filter on ad status id (ex: status "1", active)
    
    
        filters.ads
        array(int)
        []
        -
        filter on ad id (ex: ad id "1")
    
    
        filters.adsources
        array(int)
        []
        -
        filter on connection id (ex: connection id "1")
    
    
        filters.advertisers
        array(int)
        []
        -
        filter on advertiser id (ex: advertiser id "1")
    
    
        filters.browser
        array(text)
        []
        -
        filter on browser name (ex: browser "Chrome")
    
    
        filters.connection_buy_type
        array(text)
        []
        -
        filter on connection_buy_type (ex: type "rtb")
    
    
        filters.country
        array(text)
        []
        -
        (in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format, ex: US, FR)
    
    
        filters.creatives
        array(int)
        []
        -
        
    
    
        filter on creative id (ex: creative id "1")
    
    
        filters.demand_source

About the company
Teads, The Global Media Platform. We have united and empowered the best publishers in the world and distribute ads to over 1.5Bn people every month within professionally-produced content.

Find out more on www.teads.com

Report API v1
Report API v1 requires an account on the platform with reporting rights to access the API. It relies on Teads OAuth for authentication. API users have to provide the authentication token in the Authorization HTTP header.
The API consists of one REST resource declined in 2 verbs:
A POST triggers a report, to be processed asynchronously.
A GET allows to poll the status of the previous request and to retrieve the results.

Deprecation Notice
Reports with

- 
uv flag will be deprecated starting January 1, 2024

- 
expanded finance metrics will be deprecated starting January 1, 2024, cf. the Finance metrics section

Authentication
All requests on Teads reporting APIs expect following headers:

    
         Header 
         Value 
    
    
         Authorization 
         Bearer {{OAuth bearer token}} 
    
    
         Content-Type 
         application/json 
    

Quotas & Limits
Rate limit
This API is subject to a rate limit, applied for all routes.
The server will reject the request with a standard HTTP 429 error code and Retry-After header specifying how many seconds you have to wait for before attempting another request.
The wait duration between two reports may be up to 30min.

The number of reports concurrently running is limited to two (i.e. you cannot have more than two reports being generated at the same time). Server will return the REPORTING.ERROR.RUNNING_REPORT_QUOTA_REACHED error if this limit is reached.
You have to wait for previously requested reports to finish computing to request a new one, or cancel a processing report (see "List processing reports" and "Cancel processing report" sections).

Quotas
The number of generated reports is limited to 50 per 24h sliding window. Server will return the REPORTING.ERROR.PAST_24H_REPORT_QUOTA_REACHED error if this quota is reached.

Report period limits
There are limitations on the period (date.end - date.start) for a single report:

- 
Data before 2020 is not available.  Report will return the error REPORTING.ERROR.PERIOD_NOT_FULLY_AVAILABLE_IN_NEW_REPORTING_ENGINE otherwise.

- 
Maximum period is 1 year. Report will return the error REPORTING.ERROR.REPORT_PERIOD_TOO_LONG otherwise.

- 
Reports with the uv dimension and a period greater than 100 days must use the day dimension. Report will return the error REPORTING.ERROR.UV_REPORT_PERIOD_TOO_LONG otherwise.
